blocks.text: MANILA – House of Representatives Deputy Speaker Paolo Ortega V on Tuesday urged Vice President Sara Z. Duterte to heed her own call for President Ferdinand R. Marcos Jr. to resign, saying she should step down first to “set an example.” “Mauna na lang muna siguro siya para mabawasan ’yung mga hinaharap niyang problema ngayon (Maybe she should go first to reduce the problems she’s facing right now),” he said in a press briefing at the Senate. Ortega was reacting to Duterte’s call for Marcos to resign and the Chief Executive’s subsequent response to her criticisms, saying, “You cannot force anyone […]...
